consts.name: dmbRiceUsesCount
consts.comment: the rice uses count - rice used in a multitude of ways: boiled main course, gruel, leftovers mixed with meats and vegetables, vinegared and served cold, pounded into rice-cakes, ground into flour for buns or noodles, mashed and fermented into sake, seven uses (print capture p. 307)

consts.name: dmbBeanVarietiesCount
consts.comment: the bean varieties count - soybeans, red beans, black beans, and brown beans, four varieties (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbRiceTheConstant
bools.comment: the rice constant - rice the one constant throughout the civilized lands of Kara-Tur, everyone eats rice and it is served with virtually every meal (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbEatenRiceGreeting
bools.comment: the eaten rice greeting - in Shou Lung and Tu Lung people greet each other not with the friendly Hello of the west but with Have you eaten rice today (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbRiceStuffOfLife
bools.comment: the rice stuff of life - like wheat in the west, rice is the stuff of life in Kara-Tur (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbPoorMansSubstitutes
bools.comment: the poor man substitutes - when rice is unavailable or too valuable, yellow millet, sorghum, or barley substituted, the poor man food, pounded into cakes or cooked into a thick gruel (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbBeansWithRice
bools.comment: the beans with rice - beans used in addition to or in place of rice, stewed or mashed into a paste (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbBeanPasteVariety
bools.comment: the bean paste variety - the paste fermented, flavored, dried, or sweetened, used as a dip, stuffed into buns, formed into candies, or used as a sauce (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbSoyPreparedFoods
bools.comment: the soy prepared foods - from soybeans come the unusual prepared foods soy sauce and tofu (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbTofuFromSoyMilk
bools.comment: the tofu from soy milk - tofu prepared from the juice or milk of mashed soybeans, curdled and pressed into semi-soft cakes, stewed, dried, or deep-fried (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbSoySauceProcess
bools.comment: the soy sauce process - soy sauce prepared through mashing, fermenting, soaking, and rinsing, a thin salty sauce used as a flavoring for nearly anything (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbVegetablesNextToRice
bools.comment: the vegetables next to rice - next to rice in importance come vegetables of many types and flavors, grown in family garden plots, stewed, fried, pickled, and steamed (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbVegetablesRarelyRaw
bools.comment: the vegetables rarely raw - they are almost never eaten raw except as garnishes (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbGardenVariety
bools.comment: the garden variety - along with the vegetables an assortment of fruits, nuts, grasses, and flowers, from bamboo shoots and water chestnut roots to persimmons, lychees, and many others (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbPickledPreparations
bools.comment: the pickled preparations - pickled greens or radishes often with chilies, pickled plums with virtually anything pickled, dried flower buds, dried chestnuts, and pastes (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbWaterProductsImportant
bools.comment: the water products important - the products of the water important to the Oriental diet, consumed only by those living near the sea, a river, or lake (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbFishHundredsOfVarieties
bools.comment: the fish hundreds of varieties - hundreds of varieties of fish eaten, taken fresh from the water, from the commonplace to the exotic (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbDelicaciesAndDangers
bools.comment: the delicacies and dangers - the desired delicacies include the pufferfish (deadly poisonous if incorrectly prepared), sea cucumber, jellyfish, octopus, eels, shrimp, and fish maw (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbKelpHarvested
bools.comment: the kelp harvested - various types of kelp harvested from the ocean to be dried and used in soups and as flavorings (print capture p. 307)

bools.name: dmbSeaFullyUsed
bools.comment: the sea fully used - virtually anything that comes from the sea is used in some way (print capture p. 307)
